battle.name: 唐朝統一戰爭
battle.brief: 隋末群雄並起，618年五月李淵在長安建唐，李世民以秦王行軍總管統兵，先於淺水原破宋金剛，再於虎牢關擒夏王竇建德，圍洛陽迫王世充出降，繼而於洺水擒劉黑闥，戰線由關中推至中原河北。卡面的羅馬方陣盾並非唐軍裝備，唐軍對應者是用於結陣的大盾、偏廂車與拒馬槊，同屬咬合盾緣的盾牆傳統。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 這場戰爭是唐王朝建立者李淵父子於隋末群雄並起之際進行的全國統一戰爭，時間自公元618年五月李淵在長安即位起，經武德年間平定中原與河北的割據勢力，至貞觀初年基本結束。唐軍一方由李淵建立的唐朝中央政府主導：關中以李淵、李建成領兵，李世民自617年起以秦王行軍總管的身份統兵，設行軍總管府與天策府統率各道行軍，兵制以關隴府兵為骨幹，配合山東關中良家子與歸附部眾；作戰序列上，李孝恭統軍南下平蕭銑與輔公祏，李靖統軍平蕭銑並經營江南與吐谷渾、東突厥，李勣即隋末的徐茂公，後受賜姓李，專責平定梁師都與北方邊患。反方並非單一國家，而是多個彼此並立又互相攻伐的地方割據政權：河北有竇建德，其人建國號夏，倚重河北州縣與漳水一帶起兵的農軍；河南洛陽有王世充，他先奪權於宇文化及，再於619年廢隋恭帝自立，國號鄭；關中東面有劉武周與其部將宋金剛，梁師都則據守陝北與夏州；江淮有李密、杜佑，江陵與湖南有蕭銑，兗州有孟海公，山東有張金用。絕大多數割據者沿用隋制州縣、徵發兵丁、擁兵自重，軍令與糧秣各自為政，所以此役既是中央與地方之戰，也是各割據集團爭奪關中與中原最後歸屬的系列決戰。
countriesEn: This war was the nationwide unification campaign carried out by the founders of the Tang dynasty, Li Yuan and his sons, at a moment when the Sui empire had collapsed and dozens of regional warlords were fighting over the realm. It ran from the month of May in 618 CE, when Li Yuan proclaimed himself emperor at Chang'an, through the campaigns of the Wude era that cleared the Central Plain and Hebei of separatist forces, and was essentially complete in the first years of the Zhenguan reign. On the Tang side the command structure was the court of the new dynasty founded by Li Yuan. In the Guanzhong basin Li Yuan and Li Jiancheng led the field armies, while Li Shimin, holding the title Prince of Qin and serving as travelling general-in-chief from 617 onward, directed the actual operations through his own headquarters and the Tengce fu. The rank and file came from the fubing military households of Guanzhong and Longxi, supplemented by households of good family (liangjiazi) drawn from the eastern provinces and by the troops of submitted warlords. The task was divided among several commanders: Li Xiaogong led the southern drive against Xiao Xian and Fu Gongshi, Li Jing took Xiao Xian in the south and later handled the campaigns in the Jiangnan region, against the Tuyuhun and against the Eastern Turks, and Li Ji, formerly the rebel general Xu Maogong and later given the surname Li, was given the northern command, the reduction of Liang Shidu and the frontier war. The opposition was not a single state but a cluster of regional regimes that fought one another as much as they fought the Tang. In Hebei stood Dou Jiande, who founded a state and took the title Prince of Xia, drawing on the commanderies of Hebei and on the peasant risings around the Zhang river. At Luoyang in Henan stood Wang Shichong, who had first seized power from Yuwen Huaji and in 619 deposed the Sui Emperor Gong to proclaim himself emperor of Zheng. East of the Guanzhong plain lay the kingdom of Liu Wuzhou and his general Song Jingang, while Liang Shudu held the northern Shaanxi plateau and the city of Xia. There were Li Mi and Du You in the Jianghuai region, Xiao Xian in Jiangling and the Hunan lake country, Meng Haigong in Yanzhou, and Zhang Jinyong in Shandong. Almost all of these rulers kept the Sui administrative framework, levied their own soldiers and ran their own orders and supply, so this was at once a war between a central government and the provinces and a series of decisive contests among the regional powers for the final ownership of Guanzhong and the Central Plain.
people: 關鍵人物集中在李氏父子與一批開國將相。唐高祖李淵出身北周八柱國之家，時任太原留守，617年在太原起兵，618年五月在長安即位為帝，619年移都長安後坐鎮關中供應全軍。齊王李建成領右衛率長駐洛陽，負責河北方向；齊王李元吉後改封趙王，領右武候大將軍出鎮太原，兄弟之間的儲位之爭自621年後公開化。唐太宗李世民是此役的實際統帥：617年隨父起兵後獨當一面，619年冬在淺水原以精騎斷宋金剛糧道、迫其求和，620年再戰全勝；621年三月率精兵東出，取洛陽，並在虎牢關破竇建德；622年又在洺水設伏擒劉黑闥，河北自此歸唐。名將李靖以行軍總管身份平蕭銑、滅東突厥、平吐谷渾；李勣長期經營河北與河東，是消滅梁師都的主力；李孝恭、段志玄、秦叔寶、尉遲敬德、柴紹、屈突通等各統一軍。李建成與李元吉屢次請兵分權並陰謀對付李世民，終於在626年七月初七的玄武門之變中被殺，李世民數日後受逼迫退位，即位為帝。反方領袖竇建德善能用兵、得河北人心，敗後不降，於625年被處死；王世充困守洛陽十餘月，援軍覆滅後出降；劉黑闥兩度起兵，終不能成；宋金剛在淺水原敗後僅以身免，逃奔吐谷渾而死。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities are the Li brothers together with a group of generals who founded the dynasty. Li Yuan, later Emperor Gaozu of Tang, came from a family of pillar-commanders of the Northern Zhou and was serving as the military governor of Taiyuan; he rose at Taiyuan in 617, proclaimed himself emperor at Chang'an in May 618, and after moving the capital to Chang'an in 619 he stayed in the west to feed the armies. Li Jiancheng, Prince of Qi, commanded the Right Guard and was stationed at Luoyang for the northern front. Li Yuanji, also made Prince of Qi and later Prince of Zhao, was Right Martial Guard commander and governor of Bingzhou, and the rivalry over the succession between the brothers became public after 621. The real master of the campaign was Li Shimin, later Emperor Taizong. After the rising of 617 he was given an independent command, and in the winter of 619 he cut the supply of Song Jingang at the shallow-water plain with picked cavalry and forced him to ask for terms, winning the renewed engagement outright in 620. In March 621 he led picked troops east, took Luoyang and destroyed Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass; in 622 he ambushed Liu Heita at Mingshui and took him alive, and Hebei was thereafter Tang. The famous commander Li Jing, as a travelling general-in-chief, destroyed Xiao Xian, annihilated the Eastern Turks and campaigned against the Tuyuhun. Li Ji worked the northern theatre for years and became the instrument that erased Liang Shudu. Li Xiaogong, Duan Zhixuan, Qin Shubao, Yuchi Jingde, Chai Shao and Qutu Tong each led a column. Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanji repeatedly asked to split the command and plotted against Li Shimin; they were killed at the Xuanwu Gate on the seventh day of the seventh month of 626, and within days Li Shimin was pressed into the abdication and took the throne. On the other side Dou Jiande, a competent commander who held the affection of Hebei, refused to surrender after his defeat and was executed in 625. Wang Shichong, shut up in Luoyang for more than a year, came out and surrendered once his relief army was destroyed. Liu Heita rose twice and was finished the second time, and Song Jingang escaped the shallow-water plain with his life alone and died in Tuyuhun.
kits: 此役的兵器格局由唐軍的重甲步騎與各割據者的輕兵快速突擊共同構成。唐軍主力裝備是步槊、方天畫戟與橫刀，配以明光鎧一類銅葉甲胄，騎兵中以李世民所招的玄甲軍最為精銳，士卒著皂衣玄甲，衝鋒時以長槊破陣、斬馬刀砍殺。《通典》所記唐軍攻城與野戰器械包括雲梯、井欄、壕車、撞車、發石車、偏廂車，野防則用拒馬槊與鹿角，弩兵有擲車弩與床子弩，糧車與輜重車隊則是長征與追擊的骨幹。卡面這件羅馬方陣盾是公元前二世紀至公元前三世紀羅馬軍團的裝備，用途是以凸面長方盾咬合盾緣、結成人牆，配合短劍與標槍作戰；它並不存在於唐軍序列，唐朝沒有任何一場戰役使用過這種盾，其形制與工藝同東亞的盾不屬於同一系統。與它在戰術功能上真正對應的，是唐軍的長方大盾與盾陣：弩手與步卒以大盾遮蔽正面，掩護後方的弩機與射手，前排盾手伏身、後排張弩，形成與羅馬盾牆同源的以盾結陣；唐軍的偏廂車與拒馬槊構成的車陣，同樣是靠可倚靠的實體屏障抵擋騎兵衝撞，與方陣盾咬合盾緣的防線原理相通。可以說，羅馬方陣盾象徵的是一種跨文化共通的盾牆戰術，而本役唐軍真正倚重的仍是中式大盾、槊、橫刀與弩。
kitsEn: The armament of this campaign is defined by the armoured foot and horse of the Tang on one side and by the light, fast strikes of the separatists on the other. The backbone of the Tang army was the spear (bu shao), the pole-axe (fangtian huaji) and the straight sword (heng dao), worn with bronze lamellar armour of the type known as Mingguang. Among the cavalry the elite was the Xuanjia corps that Li Shimin raised himself, whose troopers wore black cloth and blackened armour and fought with the long spear for the charge and the sabre at close quarters. The siege and field equipment recorded for the Tang in the Tongdian includes the siege ladder (yun ti), the wall-covering tower (jing lan), the hide-covered wagon (hao che), the battering ram (chuang che), the stone-throwing cart (fa shi che) and the side-hutted wagon (pian xiang che). In the open field they used the anti-cavalry pike (juma shao) and the deer-horn obstacle, their crossbowmen had the throwing-cart crossbow and the bedded crossbow, and trains of grain and baggage wagons formed the backbone of both the long march and the pursuit. The piece on the card, the Roman scutum, was the shield of the Roman legions between the second century BC and the third century AD. Its purpose was to build a wall of shields by overlapping edge against edge, worked together with the short sword and the javelin. It was not part of the Tang order of battle, and no Tang army ever carried such a shield; its form and its workmanship belong to a different technological tradition from that of East Asia. What corresponds to it functionally in Tang service is the long rectangular large shield and the shield line. Crossbowmen and foot soldiers covered their front with the large shield while the crossbow crews and shooters worked behind them, the front rank crouched and the rear rank drew its bows, producing the same principle of joining shields into a line as the Roman shield wall. The Tang side-hutted wagon and anti-cavalry pike likewise worked as a physical barrier that cavalry could charge against without breaching, which is the same logic as the scutum's edge-to-edge line. The scutum therefore stands for a shield-wall doctrine common to different cultures, while the real burden of the fighting in this campaign fell on the Chinese large shield, the spear, the straight sword and the crossbow.
tactics: 唐初作戰體系的骨架是府兵制與行軍總管府制。兵源以關隴軍府折衝府的番上兵為主，戰時加徵良家子與各道團練，行軍總管以將軍或大將軍總領一路，隋代沿用的行軍元帥府制在武德年間被大量使用，使一名主將可以統數十萬大軍。戰術上最突出的是以精騎快速打斷敵軍補給與聯繫：淺水原之役，李世民率騎兵晝夜兼程二百餘里追宋金剛，先斷其汲道與糧道，迫其求和；虎牢關之役，他率精騎三千五百人東出汜水，趁竇建德大軍疲於奔命、列陣未成，以五百騎挑戰，又以千餘玄甲騎兵擊其半渡之眾。攻城則圍而不急，先斷援再打城：洛陽之役自621年春圍城至622年正月歷時近一年，築圍城、穿地道、填塹、控糧，同時留主力於虎牢關擊敗竇建德的援軍，援軍一失，城中糧盡，王世充乃出降。誘敵渡水而擊其惰足是另一常用手段：洺水之役先以數百騎挑戰，誘劉黑闥渡水而來，再以伏兵掩擊其半濟之列。糧秣主要沿渭水、洛水與汴渠轉運，前線設倉城並屯田，遠征時以車隊隨軍運糧，護糧用偏廂車與甲士環衛，撤退則交替掩護以保存戰力。
tacticsEn: The framework of Tang warfare was the fubing military system together with the travelling general-in-chief's headquarters. The soldiers came from the rotating service of the zhechong fu of the Guanzhong and Longxi military districts, with levies of households of good family and provincial militia added in time of war. A hangjun zongguan, a general or great general, took overall command of one theatre, and the Sui institution of the travelling marshal's office was used extensively in the Wude years, which allowed a single commander to lead tens of thousands of men. The most prominent tactical feature was the use of picked cavalry to cut enemy supply and to sever contact between separated forces. At the shallow-water plain Li Shimin rode day and night for more than two hundred li in pursuit of Song Jingang, struck at his well-posts and supply line and forced him to sue for terms. At Hulao Pass he marched east with thirty-five hundred picked horsemen, caught Dou Jiande's army tired from its long march and not yet formed up, challenged it with five hundred cavalry and then broke the half-crossed enemy with a thousand or so Xuanjia riders. Besieges were not pressed immediately: the line was closed first, the relief army destroyed, and only then the city taken. The siege of Luoyang lasted from the spring of 621 to the first month of 622, close to a full year, and combined a cordon, mining tunnels, the filling of the ditch and control of the food supply, while the main force was held at Hulao to break Dou Jiande's relieving army. Once the relief was lost and the grain ran out, Wang Shichong came out and surrendered. Provoking the enemy to cross the water and striking it while its files were disordered was another standard method: at Mingshui a few hundred cavalry were sent across first to draw Liu Heita's troops into the water, and the ambush fell on the troops half across. Food and fodder moved along the Wei and Luo rivers and the Bian canal, forward depots were established and land was farmed by the army, a wagon train carried grain on the march, guarded by side-hutted wagons and armoured infantry, and the rearguard was covered in turn so that the army's strength was preserved on withdrawal.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但幾個節點相當明確。淺水原之役，李世民初戰失利，退守渭北，再出戰時以精騎三千破宋金剛，斬首數千級，俘虜萬餘，宋金剛僅以身免，後逃奔吐谷渾。虎牢關之役（621年五月），竇建德自河北率兵十餘萬來救洛陽，李世民率精騎三千五百人據虎牢，以千餘玄甲騎兵破其前鋒，斬首三千餘級，竇建德被俘，河北十餘萬眾潰散，州縣相繼歸唐。洛陽之役自621年春圍城至622年正月王世充出降，前後近一年，世民破城後收其精兵與降卒，竇建德部將王君廓等相繼降。洺水之役（622年），劉黑闥之眾被斬首萬餘級，劉黑闥本人被擒，河北再定。時間上，自618年建唐到628年基本平定內部割據，歷時約十年；若加上貞觀四年（630）滅東突厥，則到取得對漠北的控制，約十二年。
dataEn: Few figures can be verified, but the anchor points are reasonably clear. At the shallow-water plain Li Shimin's first effort failed and he fell back north of the Wei; in the renewed action he broke Song Jingang with three thousand cavalry, took several thousand heads and more than ten thousand prisoners, and Song escaped with his life alone and fled to the Tuyuhun. At Hulao Pass in May 621 Dou Jiande marched from Hebei with a hundred thousand men or more to relieve Luoyang. Li Shimin held the pass with thirty-five hundred picked horsemen, broke the enemy vanguard with a thousand or so Xuanjia riders, took three thousand heads and took Dou Jiande prisoner, after which the ten-odd myriad of his troops scattered and the commanderies of Hebei surrendered one after another. The siege of Luoyang ran from the spring of 621 to Wang Shichong's surrender in the first month of 622, nearly a year, and after the city fell the Tang took over the defenders' picked troops and surrendered men, while Dou Jiande's commanders Wang Junkuo and others followed suit. At Mingshui in 622 Liu Heita's army lost more than ten thousand men and Liu Heita himself was taken alive, and Hebei was settled for good. In time, the interval from the proclamation of the Tang in 618 to the basic clearing of the internal separatists in 628 is about ten years; counting the destruction of the Eastern Turks in Zhenguan 4 (630), control of the steppe north of the Yin mountains was reached in about twelve years.
cause: 起釀於隋末的全面崩潰。隋煬帝自610年起屢征高句麗，徭役與轉輸之苦遍及河北與江淮，611年王薄在博平起事，其後十餘年間起義遍於天下，618年隋恭帝在江都遇弒，隋朝覆亡。地方豪強與軍府將領各自擁兵據郡，州縣長吏自置官吏、徵兵、鑄錢，關中形成李淵集團，關東則有竇建德、王世充、梁師都等互相攻伐的局面；割據者或以匡扶隋室為名，或改元建國爭奪正統，李淵的目標則是把關中的地盤、關東的糧道與洛陽的東都地位合為一體。統一因此成為生存競爭：李氏若不能在關東決戰中勝出，關中的糧源與兵源都會被斷；竇建德與王世充也清楚彼此無法兩全，先後互相進攻，王世充619年廢隋恭帝自立，竇建德在河北另建夏國，兩邊爭的是最後的天命歸屬。另一層原因是邊患：突厥、吐谷渾與高句麗在北方與東北牽制兵力，關內無法長期分兵，只有先統一中原，才能把力量轉向邊防。
causeEn: It began with the general collapse of the Sui. From 610 the Sui Yangdi launched repeated campaigns against Goguryeo, and the burden of corvée labour and of transport fell across Hebei and the Jianghuai. Wang Bo rose at Boling in 611, risings spread over the empire in the years that followed, and in 618 the Sui Emperor Gong was killed at Jiangdu and the dynasty ended. Local magnates and district commanders took troops and occupied commanderies, and the district officials appointed their own functionaries, levied their own soldiers and even minted their own coin. In Guanzhong the Li Yuan group formed, while east of it Dou Jiande, Wang Shichong and Liang Shudu fought among themselves. Each separatist claimed to restore the Sui or announced a new era and a new state as a way to claim legitimacy, and Li Yuan's aim was to bring the ground in Guanzhong, the grain road of the east and the position of the eastern capital at Luoyang into one whole. Unification was therefore a matter of survival: if the Li could not win the decision in the east, both the grain and the men of Guanzhong would be cut off. Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong understood perfectly well that the two of them could not both stand, and they turned on each other in turn. Wang Shichong deposed Emperor Gong and took the throne in 619, while Dou Jiande built a state of Xia in Hebei, and the real question was which of them would hold the Mandate. There was a second cause as well, the frontier threat. The Turks, the Tuyuhun and Goguryeo tied down forces in the north and northeast, and Guanzhong could not spare troops for long; only after the Central Plain was united could the state's strength be turned towards the border.
impact: 此役把中國重新置於一個單一王朝的秩序之下，結束了自西晉末永嘉之亂以來近三百年的分裂局面，其後的貞觀之治正建立在這份統一的地面上。制度上，唐廷整頓隋末冗官、合併州縣、確定三省與尚書省六部、府兵與租庸調並行，隋代已開的科舉與律令在唐初定型，成為其後一千餘年東亞秩序的制度骨架。軍事上，統一使朝廷得以把兵鋒轉向邊疆：629年李靖夜襲定襄、630年在陰山破頗利可汗、拔其牙帳，東突厥汗國瓦解，唐於陰山以北置定襄、雲中兩都督府；其後平高昌而設安西都護府，滅吐谷渾，657年滅西突厥，668年滅高句麗，並以羈縻府州羈縻少數族群、與新羅和日本的往來建立東亞秩序。代價與隱憂也同時顯現：長年戰役與徵發令關中社會疲敝，府兵在開元年間因長期邊鎮駐防而崩解，軍隊募兵化，使貞觀末年以後連續對高句麗用兵失利，埋下盛唐中期軍制與財政轉折的種子；王世充、竇建德留下的空缺州縣與降卒安置，也在貞觀初年以括戶、租庸調調整和安輯降戶的方式處理。
impactEn: The result of this war put China once more under the rule of a single dynasty, ended a division of nearly three hundred years that had run from the Yongjia disaster at the end of the Western Jin, and the Zhenguan government that followed was built on that unity. Institutionally the Tang cleared out the redundant offices of the late Sui, merged commanderies, fixed the three departments and the six ministries of the Department of State Affairs, ran the fubing and the rent, corvée and silk system together, and gave the shape that the Sui had already begun to the examination system and the penal code; that institutional frame became the skeleton of the East Asian order for more than a thousand years afterwards. Militarily, unity allowed the court to turn its arms outward. Li Jing raided Dingxiang by night in 629 and broke the Qaghan Jiali at the Yin mountains in 630, taking his tent and breaking up the Eastern Turkic khaganate, after which the Tang set up the Dingxiang and Yunzhong governorates north of the Yin mountains. Later came the reduction of Gaochang and the establishment of the Protectorate General to Pacify the West, the defeat of the Tuyuhun, the destruction of the Western Turks in 657 and the fall of Goguryeo in 668, together with the administration of dependent peoples through commanderies and prefectures and the exchange with Silla and Japan that made up the East Asian order. The costs and the hidden dangers showed at the same time. Years of campaigning and of levies exhausted the society of Guanzhong, and the fubing collapsed in the Kaiyuan years as they were kept in the frontier garrisons for long terms; the troops were turned into recruited soldiers, and the string of failed campaigns against Goguryeo from the end of the Zhenguan era onwards was the seed of the military and fiscal change that marked the middle of the High Tang. The empty commanderies and the resettled surrendered men left by Wang Shichong and Dou Jiande were handled in the first years of Zhenguan by registering households, adjusting the rent, corvée and silk system and settling the surrendered households on the land.
result: 自618年五月李淵稱帝到貞觀初年，主要割據力量逐一被清除。劉武周與宋金剛在620年被李世民於淺水原打敗，關中穩定；蕭銑於621年為李靖與李孝恭所破，江陵與洞庭一帶平定；王世充於622年正月出降洛陽，河南歸唐；竇建德於621年虎牢關被俘，其眾十餘萬潰散，河北州縣望風歸附，他本人不降，於625年被處死；劉黑闥於622年在洺水被擒，河北再無大股割據武裝；輔公祏於623年在丹陽平定；梁師都的勢力在貞觀年間被李勣逐步壓縮，最終在夏州一帶被徹底消滅，過程延續到634年，內部割據的殘餘至此全部結束。與此同時，626年玄武門之變使皇位由李建成一系轉到李世民一系，統一的成果改由新君承擔，貞觀政治自此開始。史書對此役的具體傷亡與糧秣耗損多不載詳數，只在若干戰役留下斬首與俘虜的記載，並有坑降與屠城等處置方式，說明統一的代價並不輕。
resultEn: From Li Yuan's proclamation in May 618 to the first years of Zhenguan, the main separatist forces were removed one after another. Liu Wuzhou and Song Jingang were beaten by Li Shimin at the shallow-water plain in 620 and Guanzhong was secure. Xiao Xian fell to Li Jing and Li Xiaogong in 621 and Jiangling and the Dongting region were pacified. Wang Shichong came out of Luoyang and surrendered in the first month of 622, and Henan returned to the Tang. Dou Jiande was taken at Hulao Pass in 621, the ten-odd myriad of his men scattered, the commanderies of Hebei submitted, and he himself refused to surrender and was executed in 625. Liu Heita was taken at Mingshui in 622 and Hebei had no large armed separatist left. Fu Gongshi was put down at Danyang in 623. The strength of Liang Shudu was squeezed step by step by Li Ji and was finally destroyed around Xia prefecture, a process that ran on to 634, and with it the last traces of internal separatism were gone. At the same time the Xuanwu Gate incident of 626 passed the throne from Li Jiancheng's line to Li Shimin's, and the results of unification were carried forward by the new ruler, from whom the Zhenguan government dates. The histories record little detail on the losses and the consumption of provisions in these campaigns, giving only the numbers of heads taken and prisoners made in certain actions, and they do record the execution of surrendered men and the storming of cities, so the cost of unification was plainly not light.
